property.name: isValid
property.shortdesc: Returns true if the object specifier resolves to valid objects.

property.name: parent
property.shortdesc: The parent of the NestedStyle (a TextDefault, Paragraph, ParagraphStyle, Text, InsertionPoint, TextStyleRange, TextColumn, Line, Word, Character, Story or XmlStory).

property.name: index
property.shortdesc: The index of the NestedStyle within its containing object.

property.name: appliedCharacterStyle
property.shortdesc: The character style applied to the text. Can also accept: String.

property.name: delimiter
property.shortdesc: The delimiting expression that indicates how deeply into the paragraph the nested style is applied. Can return: String or NestedStyleDelimiters enumerator.

property.name: repetition
property.shortdesc: The number instances of the specified delimiter up to which, or through which, to apply the nested style.

property.name: inclusive
property.shortdesc: If true, the nested style is applied through the last delimiter. If false, the nested style is applied up to the last delimiter.

property.name: properties
property.shortdesc: A property that allows setting of several properties at the same time.

method.name: toSource
method.shortdesc: Generates a string which, if executed, will return the NestedStyle.

method.name: getElements
method.shortdesc: Resolves the object specifier, creating an array of object references.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.

parameter.name: handler
parameter.shortdesc: The registered event handler. Can accept: File or JavaScript Function.
